title: Sowing for a Mega Harvest in Your Life
description: In this dynamic sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner reveals the secret to unlocking a mega harvest in your life, ministry, and finances. By exploring the principles of sowing and reaping, Pastor Zehner shows how to cultivate a spirit of expectation, overcome mixed motives, and speak life over your seed. Don't miss this powerful message that will inspire you to break free from limitations and step into the promise of a harvest that's bigger than you ever imagined.
